component.name: BPM Finder App
component.summary: Audio song tempo (BPM) detector, tap metronome, and delay timing calculator

description.p: BPM Finder App is an audio tempo detection suite, interactive tap tempo metronome, and audio delay note division calculator built for music producers, DJs, audio engineers, and sound designers.

ul.li: Audio Tempo Detection: Compute song BPM and average beat intervals.
Interactive Tap Metronome: Count tempo in real time using mouse click or Spacebar.
Delay & Reverb Note Calculator: Compute millisecond values for 1/4, 1/8, 1/8d, 1/16, and triplet delay divisions.
100% Local Privacy: All Web Audio DSP calculations run 100% locally inside your browser with zero data uploads.
